articles.headline: LiveWire Group, Inc. Reports 2026 Second Quarter Financial Results
articles.summary: LiveWire reported second-quarter revenue of $9.115 million and net loss of $18.213 million, with revenue rising year over year. Revenue growth is distinguished from continued losses.
